answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A vault of per-task receipts records who did what, and the knoll of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, capped per identity per epoch, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. By the tundra of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
